start.gate: no worktree yet; user confirmed start
start.prompt: work items / slugs from user message

describe.gate: after start + first sheep-status; task.original present or collected in chat
describe.prompt: worktree path, task id, relayed user answers feedback and approval when applicable

spec.gate: artifacts.story exists and story file on disk

subtasks.gate: spec open_questions empty; status open_questions empty

review.gate: execution artifact exists; partial review_scope needs user confirm first
review.prompt: worktree path, task id, review_scope when partial

acceptance.gate: readiness.status is ready_for_acceptance; user accepts on disk summary

sync.gate: acceptance recorded or user override; readiness not fix_required or blocked
sync.user_confirm: local commit, merge main into feature branch, push feature branch

archive.gate: sync artifact exists; pre_push_merge merged on sync handoff

integrate.gate: sync artifact exists; archive artifact exists; user confirmed merge into main and push main
integrate.user_confirm: merge feature into main and push main to remote

sheep_return_contract.description: Every sheep ends its final message with compact JSON for sheep-status. Nicki forwards this JSON verbatim — do not re-read the written artifact unless readiness routing requires validation JSON or spec open_questions gate check. Sheep normally still send optional_fields; update-status.py requires only next_step.
sheep_return_contract.on_blocked: set completed_status to blocked; populate open_questions

harness_failure.prompt: worktree path, failed script route, script input, expected output contract, actual failure context, blocked pipeline step

update-status.py.notes: Required summary field is next_step only. Missing next_step → written false. Missing completed_step is allowed; task.current_step is always written. Success: written true plus path, completed_step (value or null), next_step, blockers. Input error (agent omitted next_step): written false plus errors[] naming next_step — not a harness failure; retry sheep-status with corrected JSON.
